title: The Matching Christmas Tree Pajamas for the Family and the Dog
description: Matching Christmas tree pajamas for the whole family and the dog, all from Sam's Club: Member's Mark women's, kids' and pet family sleep in green, a Member's Mark snowman holiday throw and a jumbo Lamb Chop dog toy.
intro: If the dog isn't in the Christmas morning photo, did it even happen? These are the Member's Mark family pajamas in the cream and green tree print, and they come in women's, kids' and, yes, dog. So everybody matches, including the one who's going to eat the wrapping paper. Add a snowman throw for the couch and a giant Lamb Chop so he has his own present to open. That's the whole morning sorted.

sections.heading: The matching set
paragraphs: Member's Mark Women's Family Sleep and Member's Mark Kids Family Sleep, both in the green Christmas tree print on cream jersey. Two-piece sets with striped cuffs, and the women's pants have a red drawstring.

sections.heading: For the dog
paragraphs: Member's Mark Pet Family Sleep in the same green tree print, sized S to XL. Plus the Multipet Jumbo Lamb Chop plush, because he deserves a present too.

sections.heading: For the couch
paragraphs: The Member's Mark Holiday Lounge Throw, 60 by 70 inches, in the Joyful Snowman print.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The living room, the tree, the gifts and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
